description: Saw the mud on the hem and left it until it is dry.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the candle as the firing sixpence and told Alse to leave the hem.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat under the candle, then took the settle.
name: Gib

description: Marked St Luke and did not open a second book.
name: William Shakespeare
